The bombing of the Dah Sun Gambling Den, 
Nantao, as reported by the Sin Shun Pao on April 8, 
1941 has been confirmed. Particulars of the case 
are as follows :t- 

At about 5 p.m., April 7, a bomb suddenly 
exploded underneath a table in the Dah Sun Gambling 
Den, 40/41 Heng Oen Fong ( ve -§ 45), Fang Pang 
Road, Nantao. The force of the explosion was 
small and only three gamblers were slightly injured. 
Immediately after the incident, Japanese gendarmes 
and Chinese Police searched all other gambling dens 
in the vicinity but without result. It was 
suspected that the bombing was instigated by rivel 
gambling dens.

            REPORT            Date September 3. 19 41.

Subject (in full) Reported explosion in the Green Spot Gambling Den, Nantao.

Made by D. I. Pan Tien Pih    Forwarded by D. S. I. Wilcox

With reference to the attached newspaper
translation which appeared in the August 30th issue
of the Cheng Yien Pao, regarding a bomb explosion
in the Green Spot Gambling Den, Lu Shiang Yuen Road
(露香園路), Nantao, resulting in a number of
persons being wounded, I have to state that the
report is quite groundless nor was there any person
wounded.
19/3/9.

Dubail, and Wu Ho Fang (和合坊), Avenue Joffre, but
without result. Subsequently, the same party visited
the Dah Woo Hotel (大沪飯店) on Avenue Edouard VII and
in Room 407 arrested Hsu Li-sun (徐利孫), age 25, son of
Hsu Hung-fah (徐鴻法), native of Pootung, and two of his
friends. The arrested men have been taken by the Japanese
to the Gendarmerie Headquarters in Hongkew.

It is learned that the object of the raid
was to effect the arrest of Hsu Hung-fah, but he was out
when the Japanese and the French Police called.

Hsu Hung-fah used to be a mason. Prior
to the hostilities, he was once sentenced for a certain
offence and was released on the outbreak of hostilities.
Then he gathered together a number of desperadoes in
Pootung and called himself a commander. They
committed robberies and other crimes. Later he
surrendered to the Japanese and has since been nicknamed
the "Pootung France". Subsequently it was discovered
that his subordinates were responsible for the murder of
several Japanese soldiers. He absconded and the Japanese
issued an order for his arrest.

Sin Shun Pao (Japanese-owned Chinese language newspaper)
published the following editorial on August 29: -

THE THREE POWER CONFERENCE : EVENTS IN THE FAR EAST
AND NEAR EAST

The three Power conference which has been
jointly proposed to be held in Moscow by Roosevelt and
Churchill, has been postponed and nothing more has been
heard about it. It is not known whether the meeting
will ever be held.

After the British troops advanced into
Iran, Soviet Russia, under the same pretext, invaded
the north of Iran. Simultaneously, the critical
situation created by the encircling movement of America
and England in the Pacific was loosened. The advance
into Iran by England and Russia is due to a mutual
agreement of aggression. England and Russia cannot now
be regarded as standing on the same front against
Germany.

From the result of the meeting of England
and America at sea, one can see that England has no
intention to launch an attack against Germany for the
time being. The invasion of Iran by England is intended
to provide favourable conditions for future use.
pages.zh:
1941年8月30日。晨间译文。

《正言报》、《新闻报》、《中美日报》、
《申报》、《国民新闻》——

法租界逮捕华人

8月28/29日午夜，日本人与一队法国警察联合搜查了杜美路 (Avenue Dubail) 的万年坊和霞飞路 (Avenue Joffre) 的和合坊，但一无所获。随后，同一伙人前往爱多亚路 (Avenue Edouard VII) 的大沪饭店，在407房间逮捕了徐利孙（25岁，浦东人，徐鸿法之子）及其两名朋友。被捕者已被日本人带往虹口宪兵队总部。

据悉，此次突袭旨在逮捕徐鸿法，但当日本人和法国警察上门时，他外出了。

徐鸿法曾是一名泥瓦匠。战事爆发前，他曾因某项罪行被判刑，并在战事爆发时获释。随后，他在浦东聚集了一群亡命之徒，自封为司令。他们实施抢劫和其他犯罪活动。后来他向日本人投降，此后被戏称为“浦东法兰西”。随后发现，其手下对数名日本士兵的谋杀案负责。他潜逃后，日本人发布了逮捕令。

日资中文报纸《新顺报》于8月29日发表以下社论：——

三国会议：远东与近东事态

由罗斯福和丘吉尔共同提议在莫斯科举行的三国会议已推迟，此后未再听到相关消息。不知该会议是否还会举行。

英军进入伊朗后，苏联以同样的借口入侵了伊朗北部。同时，美英在太平洋的包围行动所造成的紧张局势得以缓解。英俄进入伊朗是由于侵略的共同协定。现在不能认为英俄站在对抗德国的同一阵线上。

从英美海上会议的结果可以看出，英国目前无意发动对德攻击。英国入侵伊朗旨在为未来使用提供有利条件。

pages.en:
August 30, 1941. Morning Translation.

Furthermore, it is doubtful whether America is in complete
agreement with England over the new developments in the
Near East. According to a Japanese spokesman in Tokyo,
Cordell Hull has denounced the advance into Iran by
England.
As for the Far East, the real intentions
of America to negotiate with Japan have been thwarted by
the absurd speech delivered by Winston Churchill. In
fact, we should not pay too much attention to America's
proud attitude or her attitude of respect toward Japan.
America cannot change her hostile attitude towards
Japan's mutual prosperity order.

Cheng Yien Pao :-

HAND GRENADES HURLED INTO GREEN SPOT GAMBLING DEN AT NANTAO

At 5 p.m. yesterday, a large party of
Japanese gendarmes surrounded Lu Shiang Yuen Road (露香園路)
and vicinity in Nantao and proclaimed martial law in the
area. A house-to-house search was conducted.
It was later learned that at 5 p.m.
yesterday, two hand grenades were hurled into the gambling
rooms of the Green Spot Gambling Den on Lu Shiang
Yuen Road and exploded. After the incident, a large
party of Japanese gendarmes were rushed to the scene and
proclaimed martial law. It was rumoured at one time
that a Japanese had been shot in Nantao.
It is said that many people were injured
by the explosion in the gambling den.

Chinese-American Daily News, Shun Pao, National Herald :-

Martial Law in Nantao

At 6.30 p.m. yesterday, Japanese soldiers
proclaimed martial law in Nantao and all the iron gates
along the border of the French Concession and Nantao
were closed and traffic was interrupted.
It is reported that the proclamation of
the martial law was connected with the rural purification
work.

Cheng Yien Pao, Chinese-American Daily News, Shun Pao,
National Herald :-

REPORTED BROADCAST BY JUDGE OF SHANGHAI FIRST
SPECIAL DISTRICT COURT UNTRUE.

According to a newspaper report, a
certain Judge of the Shanghai First Special District
Court recently delivered an address over a broadcasting
station on the problem of disputes over the leasing
of houses.
Our reporter made enquiries at the First
Special District Court and was informed that the above
report is untrue.
pages.zh:
1941年8月30日。晨间译文。

此外，美国是否完全同意英国在近东的新动向也令人怀疑。据东京一位日本发言人称，科德尔·赫尔 (Cordell Hull) 已谴责英国进入伊朗。
至于远东，美国与日本谈判的真实意图已被温斯顿·丘吉尔发表的荒谬演讲所挫败。事实上，我们不应过多关注美国的傲慢态度或其对日本的尊重态度。美国无法改变其对日本“共荣秩序”的敌对态度。

《正言报》：——

手榴弹投掷入南市“绿宝”赌场

昨日下午5时，大批日本宪兵包围了南市露香园路及其附近地区，并在该区域宣布戒严。进行了挨户搜查。
后来得知，昨日下午5时，两枚手榴弹被投掷进露香园路“绿宝”赌场的赌博室内并爆炸。事发后，大批日本宪兵赶赴现场并宣布戒严。一度有谣言称一名日本人在南市被枪击。
据说赌场爆炸造成多人受伤。

《中美日报》、《申报》、《国民新闻》：——

南市戒严

昨日下午6时30分，日军在南市宣布戒严，法租界与南市边界沿线的所有铁门均被关闭，交通中断。
据报道，宣布戒严与乡村净化工作有关。

《正言报》、《中美日报》、《申报》、
《国民新闻》：——

报道上海第一特区地方法院法官广播讲话不实。

据报纸报道，上海第一特区地方法院某法官近期通过广播电台就房屋租赁纠纷问题发表了讲话。
本报记者向第一特区地方法院查询，获悉上述报道不实。

CONFIDENTIAL
MUNICIPAL POLICE
REGISTRY
August 26, 1940
Gambling Dens in Nantao
The six gambling dens in Nantao resumed operations
on August 14 after having agreed to pay $1,000 each per day
to the Shanghai Special Municipal Government in addition to
$2,000 each per day to the Shanghai District Relief Association,
gambling den controlling organ in Nantao.
Immediately after resumption, the Shanghai Garrison
Headquarters (Japanese) demanded that the dens pay $2,000 each
per day and stated that the iron gate at Rue Hue, which provides
a shorter route from the Concession to the gambling dens, would
remain closed as long as the demand was not complied with.
The demand was accepted and the iron gate at Rue Hue was
re-opened on August 19. The dens commenced paying on August
24.
FILE
2582
Each of the six gambling dens in Nantao is therefore
paying a total of $5,000 per day to the authorities concerned.
The burden being heavy, the conductors of the dens are curtailing
food supplies and transportation facilities for gamblers and
charging higher "commissions" on winnings

南市赌场
南市的六家赌场在同意每天向上海特别市政府支付1,000美元，并每天向上海区救济协会（南市赌场管理机构）支付2,000美元后，于8月14日恢复营业。
恢复营业后，上海警备司令部（日本方面）立即要求每家赌场每天支付2,000美元，并表示只要不满足这一要求，作为从租界通往赌场捷径的胡路 (Rue Hue) 铁门将保持关闭。
该要求被接受，胡路铁门于8月19日重新开放。赌场于8月24日开始付款。

CONFIDENTIAL.
August 11, 1941.

Gambling Dens in Nantao - to re-open on
August 14, 1941.

The six gambling dens in Nantao, which suspended
operations on August 1, 1941 in consequence of an order of
the Shanghai Special Municipal Government requiring each of
the dens to pay $1,000 per day to the government, are expected
to re-open on August 14.

Through the efforts of Ken Chia Chi (耿嘉基),
Head of the Shanghai District Relief Association, gambling
den controlling organ in Nantao, and Lee Siao Pao (李筱寶),
follower of Colonel Lu Ying, Commissioner of the Shanghai
Special Municipal Government Police Bureau, and conductor of
the See Yuen Gambling den in Nantao, an agreement has been
reached between the gambling den conductors and the Shanghai
Special Municipal Government to the effect that each gambling
den will pay $500 per day to the government for the first
ten days after resumption of business and will pay $1,000 per
day thereafter when business is expected to improve. The
dens will continue to pay $3,000 each per day to the Shanghai
District Relief Association.

CONFIDENTIAL

August 5, 1941.

Gambling Dens in Nantao

All the 6 gambling dens in Nantao suspended
operations on August 1, 1941, in consequence of an order
of the Shanghai Special Municipal Government requiring each
of the dens to pay $1,000 per day to the Shanghai Special
Municipal Government, the latter being in need of funds
to finance the organization of the Shanghai Special
Municipal Peace Preservation Corps. A list of the dens
is given hereunder :-

(1) Si Yuan Tea Room             1451 Chung Hwa Road.
    (西園茶室)
(2) Tung Ching Tea Room          37 Tung Ching Ka, Boulevard
    (同慶茶室)                   des Deux Republiques.
(3) Loo Pao Tea Room             775 Boulevard des Deux
    (綠宝茶室)                   Republiques.
(4) Hwa Ming Tea Room            1621 Chung Hwa Road.
    (華民茶室)
(5) Wing On Tea Room             47 Loo Haiang Yuen Road.
    (永安茶室)
(6) Dah Sung Tea Room            40-41 Heng An Fong, Fong
    (大生茶室)                   Pan Road, Nantao.

Prior to suspension, the dens paid a protection fee
of $2,000.00 each per day to their controlling organ, the
"Shanghai District Relief Association" (上海救濟協會),
No. 1178, Woo Ping Road, off Old West Gate, Nantao
(the Shanghai Special Municipal Government received no share)
but they experienced difficulties in making this additional
payment owing to poor business and had to suspend operations
for the time being.

Upon learning of the attitude of the den managements,
the Shanghai Special Municipal Government took further
action by closing four of the large dens namely :-
Si Yuan, Tung Ching, Loo Pao and Hwa Ming.

(4) 华民茶室             中华路1621号。
(5) 永安茶室             露香园路47号。
(6) 大生茶室             南市方浜路恒安坊40-41号。

停业前，这些赌场每天向其管理机构“上海区救济协会”（地址：南市老西门外武平路1178号）支付保护费2,000.00美元（上海特别市政府未从中分成），但由于生意不佳，它们在支付这笔额外款项方面遇到困难，不得不暂时停业。

西园、同庆、绿宝和华民。

CONFIDENTIAL
August 5, 1941.
Gambling Dens in Nantao

All the 6 gambling dens in Nantao suspended
operations on August 1, 1941, in consequence of an order
of the Shanghai Special Municipal Government requiring each
of the dens to pay $1,000 per day to the Shanghai Special
Municipal Government, the latter being in need of funds
to finance the organization of the Shanghai Special
Municipal Peace Preservation Corps. A list of the dens
is given hereunder :-

(1) Si Yuan Tea Room
(西園茶室)
1451 Chung Hwa Road.

(2) Tung Ching Tea Room
(同慶茶室)
37 Tung Ching Ka, Boulevard
des Deux Republiques.

(3) Loo Pao Tea Room
(綠宝茶室)
775 Boulevard des Deux
Republiques.

(4) Hwa Ming Tea Room
(華民茶室)

(5) Wing On Tea Room
(永安茶室)
47 Loo Hsiang Yuen Road.

(6) Dah Sung Tea Room
(大生茶室)
40-41 Heng An Fong, Fong
Pan Road, Nantao.

Prior to suspension, the dens paid a protection fee
of $2,000.00 each per day to their controlling organ, the
"Shanghai District Relief Association" (上海救濟協會),
No. 1178, Woo Ping Road, off Old West Gate, Nantao
(the Shanghai Special Municipal Government received no share)
but they experienced difficulties in making this additional
payment owing to poor business and had to suspend operations
for the time being.

Upon learning of the attitude of the den managements,
the Shanghai Special Municipal Government took further
action by closing four of the large dens namely :-

April 10, 1941.

Dah Sun Gambling Den, Nantao, bomb explosion.
--------------------------

The bombing of the Dah Sun Gambling Den,
Nantao, as reported by the Sin Shun Pao on April 8,
1941 has been confirmed. Particulars of the case
are as follows :-

At about 5 p.m., April 7, a bomb suddenly
exploded underneath a table in the Dah Sun Gambling
Den, 40/41 Heng Oen Fong (恒安坊), Fang Pang
Road, Nantao. The force of the explosion was
small and only three gamblers were slightly injured.
Immediately after the incident, Japanese gendarmes
and Chinese Police searched all other gambling dens
in the vicinity but without result. It was
suspected that the bombing was instigated by rival
gambling dens.

FILE

1941年4月10日。

南市大生赌场爆炸案。
---

《新闻报》1941年4月8日报道的南市大生赌场爆炸案已获证实。案件详情如下：-

4月7日下午5时许，一枚炸弹突然在南市方浜路恒安坊40/41号的大生赌场内一张桌子底下爆炸。爆炸威力较小，仅有三名赌客受轻伤。事发后，日本宪兵和中国警察立即搜查了附近的所有其他赌场，但一无所获。据怀疑，此次爆炸是由 rival 赌场唆使所致。

April 8, 1941. Morning Translation

Chinese-American Daily News, Shun Pao and Sin Wan Pao :-

THE CHINESE COUNCILLORS OF THE S.M.C.

According to a statement made yesterday by Mr. L.T. Yuan, the Chinese Ratepayers Association has not yet decided on the steps to be taken in connection with the approaching Municipal elections. It is not likely that a meeting by the Association will be called to hold an election to fill the vacancies caused by departing Councillors.
According to a tentative agreement reached by the Consuls-General for Britain, America and Japan, the number of Chinese seats on the S.M.C. has been reduced by one (that is, from 5 to 4). As there are two Chinese Councillors at present remaining in Shanghai, there are two vacancies. Various quarters are closely watching the question of filling these vacancies, because owing to the present difficult conditions, the position of a Chinese Councillor is entirely different from that of foreign Councillors. On this account, developments in the matter are being awaited with great interest.

Chinese-American Daily News (comment) :-

Sanction by Chinese Government necessary

According to information received yesterday, the British, American and Japanese nominees have been selected. The number of these candidates will be in accordance with the changes made by the Consuls-General for Britain, America and Japan. The nomination of the German candidate was also announced yesterday. There is a report that no elections are to be held if the list of candidates is approved by the Special Ratepayers Meeting and that these candidates are automatically elected. We are of the opinion that everybody will voice an objection to such a procedure.
We have repeatedly stated that any changes in the Land Regulations will not be legal unless they are approved by the Chinese Government. In a statement made a few days ago, the S.M.C. admitted that the Chinese Government would be consulted, but according to present reports, the measure will become legal when it is passed by the Special Ratepayers Meeting. The affair is really very mysterious.
We strongly believe that these reports are not true. We are also convinced that unless the changes are approved by the Chinese Government, they are illegal and will not be accepted by the Chinese people or by any right-thinking members of other communities.

Sin Shun Pao (Japanese-owned Chinese language newspaper) :-

NANTAO GAMBLING DEN BOMBED

At about 5 p.m. yesterday, a bomb was hurled into the premises of the Teh Sun Club (德森俱樂部) at No. 12, Hang An Fang (恒安坊), Fang Pang Road (方浜路), Nantao. The bomb exploded and injured five persons.
The bomb throwers disappeared during the commotion. The injured men were removed to hospital for treatment. The authorities are investigating the affair.

P. T. C.
pages.zh:
1941年4月8日。晨间译稿

《中美日报》、《申报》和《新晚报》：-

工部局华董

据袁履登先生昨日发表的声明，华人纳税会尚未就即将到来的市政选举采取何种步骤作出决定。该会不太可能召开会议举行选举，以填补因离任董事造成的空缺。
根据英国、美国和日本总领事达成的初步协议，工部局中的华董席位减少了一个（即从5个减至4个）。由于目前留在上海的华董有两名，因此有两个空缺。各方密切关注填补这些空缺的问题，因为鉴于目前的困难局势，华董的地位与外籍董事完全不同。因此，人们正怀着极大的兴趣等待此事的发展。

《中美日报》（评论）：-

需经中国政府批准

据昨日收到的消息，英、美、日提名人选已选定。候选人的数量将符合英、美、日总领事所作的变更。德国候选人的提名也于昨日公布。有报道称，如果候选人名单获得特别纳税人会议批准，将不举行选举，这些候选人将自动当选。我们认为，每个人都会对这种程序表示反对。
我们曾多次声明，任何土地章程的变更，除非得到中国政府的批准，否则均属非法。工部局在几天前的一份声明中承认将咨询中国政府，但根据目前的报道，该措施一旦由特别纳税人会议通过即成为合法。此事确实非常神秘。
我们坚信这些报道不实。我们也确信，除非变更得到中国政府的批准，否则它们是非法的，不会被中国人民或任何其他社区中思想端正的成员所接受。

《新闻报》（日资中文报纸）：-

南市赌场遭炸

昨日下午5时许，一枚炸弹被扔进南市方浜路恒安坊12号德森俱乐部（Teh Sun Club）的场所内。炸弹爆炸，致五人受伤。
投弹者在混乱中消失。伤者被送往医院治疗。当局正在调查此事。

P. T. C.

April 8, 1941. Morning Translation

Shun Pao :-

EMPLOYEES OF BANK OF CHINA AND BANK OF COMMUNICATIONS TO
BE RELEASED TO-DAY

According to information secured by this
paper this morning, the 100 employees of the Bank of China
and Bank of Communications, who were detained last month,
will be released to-day as a result of negotiations conducted
by members of Chinese and foreign banking circles.

Sin Shun Pao (Japanese-owned Chinese language newspaper) :-

MYSTERIOUS MOTOR CAR FOUND OUTSIDE OFFICE OF SHUN PAO

At about 6 a.m. April 7, a mysterious motor
car was parked for some time on Hankow Road opposite the
office of the Shun Pao. On account of the kidnapping of
Wong Yao-ching (王卿), Deputy Chief of the Managing
Department of the Shun Pao, the presence of this motor car
gave rise to some apprehension among the staff of the paper
and as a precautionary measure the Police were informed. A
party of detectives arrived and removed the car to the
Station for investigation.
The Police refused to disclose the number of
the licence plate of the motor car.

New China Daily News, Central China Daily News, Kuo Min Daily
News and Bing Pao :-

STRIKE OF WORKERS OF FOUR HOUSEHOLD REMOVING COMPANIES

The chauffeurs and transporting coolies of
four household removing companies have now been on strike
for several days. The situation has become worse for the
managements failed to attend the meetings set for April 1
and April 5.
It is learned that the workers have requested
the managements for an increase of 100% in wages, but the
managements are willing to grant an increase of $10 only.

Sin Wan Pao :-

STRIKE OF SPECTACLE MAKERS

Last year the makers of spectacles asked
for an increase of wages and the management promised an
increase of 60%.
Owing to the high cost of living, the
makers have now demanded a 120% increase in wages and $15
as ride allowance. When the demands were rejected by
the management, the men went on strike.
It is learned that the Police are mediating
in the dispute.

1941年4月8日。晨间译稿

《申报》：-

中国银行和交通银行职员将于今日获释

据本报今晨获得的消息，上月被拘留的中国银行和交通银行的100名职员，经中外银行界人士谈判，将于今日获释。

《新闻报》（日资中文报纸）：-

申报馆外发现神秘汽车

4月7日上午6时许，一辆神秘汽车在汉口路申报馆对面停放了一段时间。由于申报经理部副主任王卿（Wong Yao-ching）此前遭绑架，这辆车的出现引起了报社职员的一些担忧，作为预防措施，他们通知了警方。一队侦探赶到，并将该车移至警局进行调查。
警方拒绝透露该车的车牌号码。

《新华日报》、《华中日报》、《国民日报》和《晶报》：-

四家搬家公司工人罢工

四家搬家公司的司机和搬运苦力已罢工数日。由于管理层未能参加定于4月1日和4月5日举行的会议，局势进一步恶化。
据悉，工人要求资方增加100%的工资，但资方只愿意增加10美元。

《新晚报》：-

眼镜匠罢工

去年，眼镜匠要求增加工资，资方承诺增加60%。
由于生活成本高企，工匠们现在要求增加120%的工资以及15美元的车贴。当资方拒绝这些要求时，工人们举行了罢工。
据悉，警方正在调解这一纠纷。

Cheng Yien Pao, Sin Wan Pao, Shun Pao :-

GAMBLING DENS IN NANTAO REOPEN

While in Nantao yesterday, a reporter of the
Dah Kwang News Agency (大光社) learned that the question
of the re-opening of the gambling dens has been settled.
Any gambling den which pays to the Japanese a sum of
$100,000 as security will be issued a permit and will be
allowed to operate.
Up to last night, the Green Spot (綠室)
and four other gambling dens (another report gives the number
as eight) have paid this security money and obtained permits.
They have posted announcements on their doors that they
will resume business on March 17.

February 18, 1941.

Gambling dens in Nantao - suspend operations.

All gambling dens in Nantao suspended
operations in the morning of February 13, 1941,
and remain closed.

It is learned that the authorities in
Nantao recently decided to have the gambling dens
in Nantao, numbering about 20, amalgamated into
five or six places in order to show that municipal
administration in Nantao is improving. The manage-
ments of the dens, however, refused to comply with
the wishes of the authorities who then ordered the
Nantao Police Stations to enforce suspension of
operations. The managements of the dens are now
negotiating with the Nantao authorities in connection
with the proposed amalgamation.

January 6, 1941.

Attempted Assassination in the Lee Yuen Building - Den.

With reference to the reported translation
of an article entitled "Attempted Assassination
in the Lee Yuen Building - Den" from the Jem Yien
Lun, enquiries show that Siao Mo Yen (管毛狗)
alias Siao Mo Yen (小毛狗) was a member of
the Asia Public Den (亞洲娛樂場), Tsim Sha Tsui,
Kowloon. He is a notorious loafer and gambler and
at 8.30 p.m. on January 2nd, he was shot at twice
and killed outside the Lee Yuen Building Den at
Jaffe Road (金家宅), Connaught Road
(翁家弄), Wanchai. On January 5th, according to
information obtained, Kwun Po Chi one Sien Foh Yuen
(薛福元), a morphine dealer, of several parcels
of opium valued at the sum $1,000 dollars and
later through mediation by influential persons,
he promised to pay by the end of last month, $1,000

ATTEMPTED ASSASSINATION IN THE LEE YUAN GAMBLING DEN

8.1.
The Lee Yuan Gambling Den (利源賭廳) at Ching
Ka Za (金家宅), Oong Ka Loong (翁家弄), Nahtao, is
operated by Soo Chow Ah Doo (蘇州阿大), Ah Huang Ching
(阿黃清), Ai Ts Siao Pao (矮子小寶), Wei Pao-zien (衛宝泉)
and two others. On China New Year Day, a hand grenade was
thrown into the den, injuring about 10 male and female gamblers.
At about 5 p.m. yesterday, Ah Mao (阿毛), a
member of the den, was shot at twice outside the den and was
wounded. A large number of Japanese gendarmes and mercenary
policemen were detailed to the place, but the desperadoes had
already decamped. A search was made by the Japanese gendarmes
inside the den.
The wounded man was removed to a hospital by
the Japanese. It is learned that his wounds are very serious
and that his life is in danger. The cause of the shooting is
unknown.

February 1, 1941

Lee Yuan ( 利源 ) Gambling Den bombed
------

Reference to the attached translation of an
extract from the "National Herald" and two other local
dailies, reporting the explosion on January 27 of two
bombs in the Lee Yuan Gambling Den located behind
the Kung Woo Theatre, on Min Kuo Road, Nantao, etc.,
enquiries ascertained that on the morning of January
27, a bomb which was left **〔此处转录不清〕** beneath a gambling
table of the said den suddenly exploded resulting in
five persons being slightly injured. These were
later removed to the Refugee hospital, Kiu Mow Dee,
Nantso. One suspect was arrested.

The victimized gambling den, it is understood,
is located near to the Si Yuan ( 西園 ) Gambling
Den and it is generally believed that the incident
is the outcome of business competition between these
two establishments.

At 3 p.m. January 31, a handgrenade was found
unexploded underneath a table in the Nan Yuan ( 南園 )
Gambling Den, 195 Min Kuo Road, Nantso, by one of the
employees and was later removed by the Shanghai City
Government Police Bureau. Competition is suspected
to be the cause of the incident.

Commander of P.C.

1941年2月1日

利源赌场遭炸弹袭击
------

参照随附的《国民新闻》及另外两家本地日报摘录译件，报道了1月27日发生在南市民国路共和大戏院后方利源赌场的两起炸弹爆炸事件等情，经查询查明，1月27日上午，一枚被留在该赌场一张赌桌下的炸弹〔此处转录不清〕突然爆炸，导致五人受轻伤。伤者随后被送往南市九亩地难民医院。一名嫌疑人被捕。

据悉，受害的利源赌场位于西园赌场附近，人们普遍认为此次事件是这两家场所之间商业竞争的结果。

1月31日下午3时，南市民国路195号南园赌场的一名雇员在一张桌子下发现了一枚未爆炸的手榴弹，随后由上海市政府警察局移除。怀疑竞争是导致此事件的原因。

GAMBLING DEN BOMBED
The manager of the Nan Yuen (南園)
Gambling Den in Sin Kai Ho (新開河), Nantao, is one Zee
(徐) alias Dah Kou Ts (大口子), a native of Shantung. This

January 8, 1941

TAIRIKU SHIMPO

MAYOR CHEN KUNG-PO TO URGE OPERATORS OF
GAMBLING DENS AND OPIUM DENS VOLUNTARILY
TO GIVE UP THEIR BUSINESS

In view of the fact that a large number of
gambling dens are being operated publicly or semi-publicly
in the Western District and Nantao, Mayor Chen Kung-po is
determined to exterminate all gambling and opium-smoking
dens for they are greatly prejudicial to the construction of
a brighter Shanghai. He is at present conducting secret
negotiations with the authorities concerned and is urging
operators of gambling and opium smoking dens to give up their
business.

Shanghai Press :- 24/2/40 Gambling dens in Nantao, etc

REPORTED AMALGAMATION OF GAMBLING DENS IN NANTAO

During the past two or three months, about
30 gambling dens have sprung up in Nantao, the more prominent
of which are the "Si Yuan" (四園), the "Dah Sun" (大生),
the "Nan Yuan" (南園), the "Loh Pao" (洛寶) and the "Loh
Yuan" (洛園) gambling dens. However, the business of these
gambling dens is very slack and, due to the heavy expenditure
the majority of these establishments are losing money.

In view of this unfavourable state of
affairs, the Japanese are proposing to merge all the gambling
dens in Nantao into three gambling dens, as they did in
the Western District in the case of the "Loh Kuo Hotel" (洛國飯店).

P. T. O.

上海报刊：1940年2月24日 南市赌场等

报道南市赌场合并

在过去两三个月里，南市出现了约30家赌场，其中较著名的有“西园”、“大生”、“南园”、“洛宝”和“洛园”赌场。然而，这些赌场的生意非常清淡，且由于开支巨大，大多数场所都在亏损。

鉴于这种不利局面，日本人提议将南市的所有赌场合并为三家，就像他们在西区对“洛国饭店”所做的那样。

13th Dec., 40.

Male Chinese sufferring from wounds received during a bomb
explosion in a gambling den in Nantao, treated at the Lester Chinese
Hospital.
D.S.I. Suhoff.

Sir,

At 5.40 p.m. 13/12/40 a telephone message was
received at this station from the Lester Chinese Hospital
reporting admittance of a patient suffarring from
injuries received during a bomb explosion in Nantao.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE SPECIAL BRANCH）

O.D. No. 46 attended and enquiries ascertained that
the injured man is one named Hsu Ta Kuo (徐大國) age 32,
native of Wusih, residing at 49 Tung Ka Wei Rd.,
Nantao.

At about 5 p.m. on 13/12/40 he was gambling at the
Great Shanghai (大上海) Gambling Den, Zeu Cha Rd.,
Nantao, when a bomb suddenly exploded under the table
near which he was sitting and he received injury to his
left leg.

Private detective employed at this gambling den named
Chih Isung Sai (志春山) 34, Yenchow, residing at 6
Zoong Tuh Li, Zeuchow Road, Nantao, called a hire motor
car and escorted the wounded man to the Lester Chinese
Hospital.

The Dr's certificate was issued:-"Bomb wound of left
leg. Not serious." The patient was discharged after
treatment and together with the private detective brought
to this station.

The patient and the private detective denied knowing
the cause of the explosion and the number of persons
injured.

They were allowed to go, the private detective
escorted the wounded man to his residence in Nantao.

Copy to Special
Branch (direct).

Suhoff

1940年12月13日。

一名华籍男子在南市一家赌窟发生的炸弹爆炸中受伤，于莱斯中国医院接受治疗。
副督察长 Suhoff。

先生：

1940年12月13日下午5时40分，本捕房接到来自莱斯中国医院的电话报告，称收治了一名在南市炸弹爆炸中受伤的病人。

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 特务科）

第46号外勤警员前往现场，经查询查明，伤者名为徐大國（Hsu Ta Kuo），32岁，无锡人，居住于南市唐家湾路49号。

1940年12月13日下午5时许，他正在南市州路“大上海”（Great Shanghai）赌窟赌博，此时他座位附近的桌下突然发生炸弹爆炸，导致其左腿受伤。

该赌窟雇佣的一名私人侦探，名为志春山（Chih Isung Sai），34岁，扬州人，居住于南市州路宗德里6号，叫了一辆出租车，护送伤者前往莱斯中国医院。

医生出具的证明为：“左腿炸弹伤。不严重。”伤者接受治疗后出院，并与该私人侦探一同被带至本捕房。

伤者及该私人侦探均否认知晓爆炸原因及受伤人数。

二人获准离开，该私人侦探护送伤者返回其在南市的住所。

副本直送特务科。

Suhoff

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
December 4, 1940
B. D. 8097

Press report - "Hwo Wei Lottery King" beaten up

With reference to the attached translation
of extract from Cheng Vien Pao dated November 26,
1940 on the above subject, enquiries show that Li
Siao Sao ( 李 修 宝 ), a notorious Hwo Wei lottery
conductor, accompanied by two of his bodyguards, was
proceeding through the gate at Nan Yang Jao (south
end of Boulevard de Montigny,) into Nantao in a
private motor car, when they were stopped and told
by the Chinese members assisting the Japanese
Gendarmerie to alight from the car, in order to
search the inside of the vehicle. No notice was
taken of their passes. The bodyguards showed
resentment and accused the police of purposely
embarrassing Li, which resulted in an argument
but no blows were struck. The Chinese gendarmes
reported the matter to the Japanese gendarmes, and
the car and its occupants were taken to the Tia
Jao Police Bureau. They were however allowed to
go after the cause of the trouble had been
investigated.

（印：4 DEC 1940 COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE）

Li Siao Sao is at present the operator of
the Si Yuen Gambling House, Chung Hwa Road, Old
West Gate, Nantao. It is learned that when this den
was to be opened in August, 1940, he, through the
recommendation of a third party, became a disciple of
Isamu Kawakami ( 川 上 勇 ) (Japanese), Chief of the
Nantao Section of the Japanese Gendarmerie, and
presented him with a motor car for his services.

上海公共租界工部局警务处
1940年12月4日
B. D. 8097

新闻报道 - “花会彩票大王”遭殴打

关于附上的1940年11月26日《诚言报》摘录译文，涉及上述主题，经查询得知，臭名昭著的花会彩票经营者李修宝（Li Siao Sao），在其两名保镖陪同下，乘坐私家车经由南阳桥（蒙蒂尼大道南端）大门进入南市时，被协助日本宪兵队的华籍成员拦下，并要求下车以便搜查车内。他们的通行证未被理会。保镖表示不满，指责警察故意让李难堪，导致发生争执，但未发生打斗。华籍宪兵将此情况报告给日本宪兵，车辆及车内人员被带往提篮桥警察局。但在调查了事端起因后，他们获准离开。

（印：1940年12月4日 总办办公室）

李修宝目前是南市老西门中华路“西园”赌窟的经营者。据悉，当该赌窟于1940年8月准备开业时，他通过第三方推荐，成为日本宪兵队南市分队队长川上勇（Isamu Kawakami）（日本人）的门徒，并赠送其一辆汽车以表效劳。

He, however, failed to recognise the Chinese members
in a similar manner and dissatisfaction was created.
It is also learned that Li Siao Lao is on
intimate terms with General Loo Ying, Commissioner of
Police, Some seven years ago, he was chief of
detectives attached to the Chapei and West Gate Police
Stations. He absconded because of corruption having
been discovered and was wanted on a circular order
issued by the former Shanghai City Government. He
was in hiding until the withdrawal of the Chinese
troops from Shanghai at the end of 1937, when he commenced
the 'Wo Wei Lottery in the Western District. He is
reported to have amassed a large fortune through gambling.

pages.en:
November 26, 1940.
Morning Translation

Cheng Yien Pao, Chinese-American Daily News, National Herald.-

"HWO HWEI LOTTERY KING" DETEN UP

After the fall of Shanghai, Li Siao-pao (李筱宝),
the "hwo hwei lottery king," established the Si Yuan Gambling
Den (西园) outside the West Gate in Nantao and has
amassed a very large fortune. He owns a private residence
at No. 442 Jessfield Road in the Western District and a motor
car, licence No. 499. Recently, he held a funeral ceremony
for his mother under the pretext of promoting the establishment
of schools and received presents valued at nearly $100,000.
Lately he has been active in the French Concession
where he has established 30 hwo hwei lottery agencies, mostly
located in the alleyways along Rue Conty. This became known
to the French Police and strict searches were made for the
arrest of Li Siao-pao.
At about 10.15 a.m. yesterday when Li was entering
Chinese territory through the gate at the corner of Nan Yang
Jao (南阳桥) and Rue Millot in his private motor car
together with his bodyguards, he was stopped at the gate
and searched by City Government policemen and Japanese
gendarmes who asked him to produce his "resident permit"
for examination. As he holds a pass, Li refused to be
searched with the result that a dispute ensued and Li was
forcibly dragged down from his car by the Japanese gendarmes
and was given a beating from which he emerged with a broken
head through being struck with rifle butts. His two
bodyguards and the driver were likewise assaulted. Eventually
Li and his men were taken to the Japanese Gendarmerie.

（批：Sp Br / Commr / A friend of / Genl Loo / Hsh）
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL / COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE / 26 NOV. 1940 / MB）

Another Version

According to a report appearing in the Central
China Daily News" to-day, Li S'ao-pao, the "hwo hwei lottery
king," in the course of his dispute with the Japanese
gendarmes yesterday at the gate at Nan Yang Jao, was arrested
together with his bodyguards and taken to the Police Bureau.

（手写签名：S. I. Pann / Putzy）
pages.zh:
1940年11月26日。
晨间译文

《诚言报》，中美日报，国民 Herald.-

“花会彩票大王”遭拘押

上海沦陷后，“花会彩票大王”李筱宝（Li Siao-pao）在南市老西门外开设了“西园”（Si Yuan）赌窟，并积累了巨额财富。他在西区极司菲尔路442号拥有一处私宅和一辆牌照号为499的汽车。最近，他以促进建校为名为其母亲举行葬礼，收受价值近10万美元的礼物。近来他在法租界活动频繁，在那里设立了30家花会彩票代理点，大多位于孔梯埃路（Rue Conty）沿线的弄堂里。此事被法国警方获悉，并对逮捕李筱宝进行了严密搜查。
昨天上午10时15分左右，李与其保镖乘坐私家车，经由南阳桥（Nan Yang Jao）和米洛路（Rue Millot）拐角处的大门进入华界时，在门口被市政府警察和日本宪兵拦下搜查，并要求出示“居住证”以供检查。由于李持有通行证，他拒绝接受搜查，结果引发争端，李被日本宪兵强行拖下车，并遭到枪托击打，导致头部受伤破裂。他的两名保镖和司机也遭到殴打。最终，李及其手下被带往日本宪兵队。

（批：特务科 / 总办 / 陆将军的朋友 / Hsh）
（印：上海公共租界工部局 / 总办办公室 / 1940年11月26日 / MB）

另一版本

据今天《华中日报》刊登的报道，“花会彩票大王”李筱宝（Li S'ao-pao）昨天在南阳桥大门与日本宪兵发生争执期间，与其保镖一同被捕并被带往警察局。

（手写签名：S. I. Pann / Putzy）

pages.en:
November 27, 1940.

Nantao Situation.
----------

Up to the present time organized gambling
has flourished in Nantao and the number of gambling
dens which are now in operation under the authority
of permits issued by the Shanghai City Government
Police Bureau has reached 19.

Keng Kia Kee (耿嘉基), Secretary of the
now defunct Shanghai City Government, quick to grasp
an opportunity, endeavoured to establish an organization
to be known as the "Shanghai District Relief
Association" (上海市地方救濟協會) in Nantao
with the assistance of Lee Shih Chung (李士) and Ma
Siao Tien (馬嘯天), Chief and Deputy Chief of the
Political Police Bureau of Ministry of Police of the
Nanking Government. The Association will, in fact,
serve as a gambling den supervision organ, with the
object of collecting taxes monthly from the gaming
houses. The monies thus obtained are to be equally
divided into three shares, one of which will go to
the official organs in Nantao and be distributed as
allowances, one for relief work while the remaining
share will be used for rehabilitation work in Nantao,
including the expenses incurred by the Association.

House No. 1178 Woo Ping Road, off Old West Gate,
Nantao, is under repairs at present preparatory to being
taken over as the Association's office. The Association
will begin to function soon.

A list of the gambling dens is attached hereto.
pages.zh:
1940年11月27日。

南市局势。
---

截至目前，有组织的赌博在南市盛行，目前在上海市政府警察局颁发许可证授权下运营的赌窟数量已达19家。

已解散的上海市政府秘书耿嘉基（Keng Kia Kee）敏锐地抓住机会，在南京政府警察部政治警察局局长李士（Lee Shih Chung）和副局长马啸天（Ma Siao Tien）的协助下，试图在南市建立一个名为“上海市地方救济协会”（上海市地方救濟協會）的组织。该协会实际上将充当赌窟监管机构，目的是每月向赌场收税。由此获得的资金将平均分为三份，一份交给南市官方机构作为津贴分发，一份用于救济工作，剩余一份用于南市的复兴工作，包括协会产生的费用。

南市老西门外武平路1178号目前正在修缮，准备作为协会办公室。该协会即将开始运作。

随函附上赌窟名单。

Misc.734/40.
Louza
10/11/40. 8039/7/40
Male Chinese admitted to the Lester Chinese Hospital suffering
from wounds received during a bomb explosion in Nantao.
D.S.I. Sdhoff.

Sir,
At 4.20 p.m. 10/11/40 a telephone message was
received at this Station from the Lester Chinese
Hospital reporting that a male Chinese had just been
admitted there sufferring from wounds received during
a bomb explosion in Nantao.
C.D.S.342 attended and questioned the wounded
man, when the following was ascertained:-
The wounded man named Sung S Ming(沈士明) age 35,
native of Kompo, S/teaboy, employed at Ta Fah(大發)
Gambling Den at 714 Foo Yue Road(福佑路) Nantao,
residing at the same address.
At about 3 p.m. 10/11/40, a bomb was thrown at
the above gambling den, when several male Chinese
were injured. Immediately after the explosion he was
taken by a co-employee teaboy named Sung Chi Lang(沈其郎)
in a public ricksha to the Lester Chinese Hospital.
His injury was certified:- "Laceration and
Hemetoma ? amputation of right toes. Quite serious.
Detained. Will require 20 days' treatment in Hospital."
The teaboy Sung Chi Lang who escorted the injured
man to the Hospital, also did not know the particulars
about the bomb explosion in the gambling den.

Sen. Det. 1/6.
D. S. I.
C.D.S.342.

CCC/ D. D. O. "A" Divn.

杂项 734/40。
Louza
40年11月10日。 8039/7/40
一名中国男子因在南市炸弹爆炸中受伤被送入莱斯特华民医院（Lester Chinese Hospital）。
副督察 Sdhoff。

先生，
40年11月10日下午4时20分，本站接到莱斯特华民医院的电话报告，称一名中国男子刚被送入该院，其在南市的炸弹爆炸中受伤。
刑事侦缉股342号警员前往并讯问了伤者，查明情况如下：
伤者名叫沈士明（Sung S Ming），35岁，广东人，茶房，受雇于南市福佑路714号大發（Ta Fah）赌场，居住在同一地址。
40年11月10日下午3时许，一枚炸弹被扔进上述赌场，导致数名中国男子受伤。爆炸发生后，他立即由一名同为茶房的同事沈其郎（Sung Chi Lang）用公共人力车送往莱斯特华民医院。
其伤情鉴定为：“撕裂伤及血肿？右脚趾截肢。相当严重。留院观察。需住院治疗20天。”
护送伤者去医院的茶房沈其郎也不了解赌场炸弹爆炸的详细情况。

高级侦探 1/6。
副督察。
刑事侦缉股342号。

CCC/ “A”区副总监。

〔右上角印章及手写内容：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / S. B. REGISTRY / File No. ... / S. B. D... / S. 1, Special Branch Station, / Date October 1, 1940〕

REPORT

Subject Explosion of hand grenade in Si Yuan Ballroom, Nantao.

Made by D. I. Pan Lien Iih Forwarded by D. I. Crawford

At 5 p.m. September 28, a handgrenade
exploded inside the Si Yuan Ballroom, a gambling
den at 1451 Chung Hwa Road, Nantao, injuring
four patrons, who were subsequently removed to
a hospital in Nantao for treatment. The missile
was left on the premises by some unknown person
who made good his escape.

It is suspected that the bombing was
revenge and perpatrated by persons interested
in the gambling business. This gambling den
was established on August 1, 1940, and following
the opening, it is said, the conductor named
Li Siao Pao (李筱寶) made arrangements with
the Police of the Shanghai City Government to
have all other small gambling dens in the same
district closed down. Those dens were closed
by the Police on August 25, 1940, and through
their closure the business of the Si Yuan Ballroom
became very prosperous. It is reported to have
made a profit of $400,000.00 recently.

FILE

Pan Lien-pih
D. I.

报告

主题：南市西园舞厅手榴弹爆炸事件。

由副督察潘连璧（Pan Lien Iih）呈报，经副督察克劳福德（Crawford）转呈

9月28日下午5时，一枚手榴弹在南市中华路1454号的西园舞厅（一家赌场）内爆炸，致使四名顾客受伤，随后被送往南市的一家医院接受治疗。投掷物由某不明身份人士留在现场，该人已逃脱。

怀疑此次爆炸是报复行为，由与赌博业有利害关系的人士所为。该赌场成立于1940年8月1日，据说开业后，经营者李筱宝（Li Siao Pao）与上海市政府警察达成协议，关闭了同一地区的所有其他小赌场。这些赌场于1940年8月25日被警方关闭，随着它们的关闭，西园舞厅的生意变得非常兴隆。据报道，近期获利达400,000.00美元。

档案

潘连璧
副督察。

pages.en:
0986

Bomb Hurled Into
Gaming House
Nantao Becomes "Second
Badlands"; Opium Dives
Close Their Doors

Bomb-throwing threats often re-
sorted to by rival gangs in the
western district when gambling house
managers held full sway in that part
of the city in the not distant past
are now being repeated in the
"second badlands" in Nantao. While
free-for-all fights and shootings were
reported in the gambling section of
the native city recently, the first
bomb incident occurred on Saturday.
According to the "Cheng Yien Pao,"
a "phosphorus" bomb was tossed into
the biggest gambling house, the West
Garden, a newly-established business
in Chung Hwa Road shortly after
5 p.m. The missile exploded, wound-
ing four gamblers one of whom had
his four fingers blown off. The bomb
was thrown near a table around
which many were indulging in the
"21-gate" gambling game. The bomb
tosser escaped, but three suspects
were later caught by the Chinese
police.

Opium Dens Closed

Chiu Mow Ti in Nantao, a street
notorious for opium during the pre-
war days, has of late lived up to
its former reputation. The report
states that between 10 and 20 opium
hongs and opium smoking houses
are located in that street alone, but
on Friday night they suddenly
closed their doors, although gambling
houses nearby kept their doors open.
No reason for the sudden closure is
mentioned, but it is suggested that
the recent police action taken against
opium-smoking houses in Yu Yuer
Road might have had an effect on
the opium business in the native city.
As a contrast to the "badlands,"
the Settlement police have been
relentless in their drive against
gambling. Only on Saturday 12
gamblers were fined or sentenced to
prison terms by the First Special
District Court. The gamblers were
arrested by the Footoo Road police
in a small gambling establishment at
No. 4 Hung Su Fang, (Lane 284)
Mapai Road. There, the police found
them playing dice and "Pai-chiu" an
old-fashioned way of playing Chinese
cards. Several gambling sets were
confiscated by the court.
pages.zh:
0986

炸弹投掷进
赌场
南市变成“第二
恶土”；鸦片烟馆
关门歇业

在不久前的过去，当赌场经营者在该地区势力鼎盛时， rival gangs（敌对帮派）在西区经常诉诸的投掷炸弹威胁，如今正在南市的“第二恶土”重演。虽然最近华界赌博区报道了群殴和枪击事件，但第一起炸弹事件发生在星期六。据《诚言报》报道，下午5点后不久，一枚“磷”炸弹被投掷进中华路上新开业的最大赌场——西园。炸弹爆炸，炸伤四名赌徒，其中一人四指被炸断。炸弹被扔在一张桌子附近，当时许多人正围坐在那里玩“廿一点”赌博游戏。投弹者逃脱，但随后中国警察抓获了三名嫌疑人。

鸦片烟馆关闭

南市邱茂堤（音译）这条在战前以鸦片闻名的街道，最近可谓名副其实。报道称，仅该条街上就有10至20家鸦片行和鸦片烟馆，但在周五晚上，它们突然关门歇业，尽管附近的赌场仍然营业。未提及突然关闭的原因，但有人暗示，警方最近在愚园路针对鸦片烟馆采取的行动，可能影响了华界的鸦片生意。与“恶土”形成对比的是，租界警方一直在无情地打击赌博。仅在星期六，就有12名赌徒被第一特区法院罚款或判处监禁。这些赌徒是由福煦路警察在马派路284弄洪苏坊4号的一家小赌场逮捕的。在那里，警察发现他们在玩骰子和“牌九”，这是一种老式的中国纸牌玩法。法院没收了几套赌具。

Subject Political Police Bureau bans sale of pro-Chungking newspapers
in Nantao - Registration of armed guards in the employ of gambling dens.

Made by D.I. Pan Lien-pih, Forwarded by D.S.I. Logan.

〔左侧方框内文字模糊不清〕
(Sp. Ar)

With reference to the attached translation of
an article entitled "Political Police Bureau Bans
Sale of Newspapers Harmful to the Republic : Shops
And Amusement Resorts Instructed Not To Advertise
In These Newspapers," which appeared in the September
23 issue of the Central China Daily News, enquiries
show that the term "newspapers harmful to the Republic"
contained in the original text of the article refers
to all vernacular newspapers which are anti-Wang Ching
Wei in nature.

According to information obtained from a
source closely connected with the Political Police
Bureau, the latest notification instructing shops and
amusement resorts not to advertise in pro-Chungking
papers, was issued for the purpose of making known
the intention of the Bureau to eventually interfere
with the operation of the gambling dens in Nantao,
while the banning of the sale of pro-Chungking
newspapers in Nantao can only be interpreted as a
subterfuge on the part of the Bureau, when it is
remembered that ever since the occupation of Nantao
by the Japanese Army at the end of 1937, such papers
have not been allowed to be brought into the area
and that the financial position of the shops in
Nantao does not warrant the insertion of commercial
advertisements in newspapers.

（印：SHANGHAI COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE 21 SE 1940）

主题：政治警察局禁止在南市销售亲重庆报纸 - 登记赌场雇佣的武装警卫。

关于附件中题为《政治警察局禁止销售危害民国之报纸：商店及娱乐场所奉令不得在此类报纸刊登广告》的文章译文（该文刊登于9月23日的《华中日报》），经查询显示，原文中所含“危害民国之报纸”一词，系指所有反汪精卫性质的白话文报纸。

据与政治警察局关系密切的消息来源透露，最新发布的指示商店和娱乐场所不得在亲重庆报纸上刊登广告的通知，其目的是表明该局最终将干预南市赌场运营的意图；而在南市禁止销售亲重庆报纸，只能被视为该局的一种借口，因为众所周知，自1937年底日军占领南市以来，此类报纸一直不被允许带入该地区，且南市商家的财务状况也不支持在报纸上刊登商业广告。

（印：上海总监办公室 1940年9月21日）

In order to attract patrons to visit their

the Si Yuen Gambling Den and the Loh Yuan Gambling
Den, have been daily advertising in the columns of
pro-Wang newspapers while on occasion they have also
advertised in the columns of pro-Chungking newspapers.

supervision or protection of the Shanghai City
Government Police Bureau, the Political Police Bureau
has never had any share of revenue from those
establishments, hence the notification instructing them
not to insert advertisements in pro-Chungking vernacular
newspapers, which has been duly complied with.

Apart from issuing the above notification,
the Political Police Bureau on September 22nd, also
issued instructions to the gambling dens in Nantao,
calling for the registration of armed guards in their
employ and also of their firearms. It is learned,
however, that the dens have thus far ignored these
instructions.

September 23, 1940. Morning Translation

Central China Daily News, Bing Pao, Kuo Min Daily News :-

"POLITICAL POLICE BUREAU BANS SALE OF NEWSPAPERS HARMFUL TO
REPUBLIC : SHOPS AND AMUSEMENT RESORTS INSTRUCTED NOT TO
ADVERTISE IN THESE NEWSPAPERS"

Following the outbreak of hostilities in
Shanghai, thousands of miles of territory were lost and the
fertile lands in South-East China were ravaged. The peace
movement started by President Wang is receiving nation-wide
support. The nation is embarking on a programme of
reconstruction following the reorganization and the return
of the government to its old seat at Nanking.
However, a number of local newspapers, such
as the "Chinese-American Daily News," the "Ta Mei Wan Pao,"
the "China Evening News," the "Ta Ying Yeh Pao," the newly
published "Cheng Yien Pao" and others, relying upon the
influence of foreigners in the Settlement, have been
persistently conducting malicious propaganda and spreading
rumours to mislead the public. Their activities, which
amount to wilful damage of the Republic, are truly deplorable.
As business in this locality, particularly
in Nantao, is gradually improving, the Political Police Bureau
of the Ministry of Police has issued a circular order to
commercial concerns and amusement resorts in Nantao instructing
them not to advertise in the columns of the newspapers
mentioned above; in the meantime, news vendors have been
prohibited from selling these newspapers.

Ian

1940年9月23日。晨间译文

《华中日报》、《平报》、《国民新闻》：

“政治警察局禁止销售危害民国之报纸：商店及娱乐场所奉令不得在此类报纸刊登广告”

上海战事爆发后，大片国土沦丧，中国东南部的肥沃土地遭到蹂躏。汪主席发起的和平运动正得到全国范围的支持。随着政府改组并还都南京，国家正着手重建计划。
然而，一些本地报纸，如《中美日报》、《大美晚报》、《中国晚报》、《大英夜报》、新出版的《诚言报》等，依仗租界外国人的势力，持续进行恶意宣传并散布谣言以误导公众。其行为实乃故意损害民国，令人痛心。
鉴于本地业务，特别是南市的业务逐渐好转，警察部政治警察局已向南市商界和娱乐场所发布通令，指示它们不得在上述报纸专栏中刊登广告；同时，禁止报贩销售这些报纸。

Ian

9月23日

S.I. Special Branch Station,
Date September 18, 1940.

REPORT
Subject Assassination of Lieu Yung Hwa ( 刘荣华 ).

Made by D.I. Pan Lien Pih Forwarded by D.S.I. Logan

(Vide S.B.Reports
18/7/40 and
26/8/40)

At about 5 a.m. 9.9.40, Lieu Yung Hwa, one of the shareholders of the Yoong Sung ( 荣生 ) Gambling Den, 10 Lieu Yung Loong ( 刘汝弄 ), Sin Jao Ka, Kiu Mow Di, City, which was closed on 25.8.40 as per instructions of the S.M.G.P.B., and chief of the den's bodyguards, was fatally shot by three assassins outside the den in question. He subsequently succumbed to his wounds on the same day.

The deceased Lieu Yung Hwa was 39 years of age, a native of Tientsin and was residing in the premises of the said gambling den. Prior to his being assassinated Lieu was known to have been at variance with one Tsang Teh Sung ( 张德胜 ), who is a native of Shantung and is also a bodyguard employed by one of the gambling dens in the city, over business competition, and it is therefore suspected that the assassination may have been perpetrated at the instigation of Tsang Teh Sung. However, no definite evidence in this connection is at present available. There is no political significance attached to this incident.

FILE
Pan Lien Pih
D. I.

D.C. (Special Branch).

temporarily until 3 p.m. the same day, when it recom-

The gambling dens in Nantao, which opened during the past two months, closed down as from August 25, 1940, on the instructions of the Bureau of Police of the Shanghai City Government, with the exception of the following two leading ones :-

| Name and Address | Date of establishment | Conductor |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| 1. Si Yuen Ballroom (西園舞廳), 1451 Chung Hwa Rd., near Old West Gate, Nantao. | 1/8/40 | Li Siao Pao (李筱寶). |
| 2. Lee Yuen Amusement Resort. (利源娛樂場), Kien Woo Li alleyway, Ong Ka Loong, Old West Gate, City. | 17/8/40 | Kyi Keng Ling (計根林). |

Prior to August 25, 1940, there were altogether eighteen gambling dens . It is reported that their closure was ordered as the result of a joint decision of Mr. Loo Ying (盧英), Commissioner of Police, and the Japanese authorities, who considered that gambling establishments in Nantao are too numerous and therefore decided to close the smaller ones.

Pan Lien-pik
D. I.

FILE

Seven new gambling dens have established
in Nantao, thus making a total of 18 such establishments
at present operating in that area.

Details of the seven new dens are given
below :

The Tai San Happy Garden (泰山樂園 ).

The Tai San Happy Garden, a gambling den,
located at Houses Nos. 1 - 2 Ts An Li alleyway (智安里)
Loo Shiang Yuen Road, Kiu Mow Di, City, opened for
business on August 6, 1940. It is conducted by Sung
Sing Fu (沈心梅), age about 50, a native of
Hangchow, who is Chairman of the "Nantao Branch of the
Chinese Labourers' Welfare Association (中華工人福益會)"
with offices at 15 Dah Ching Road, Kiu Mow Di, City.
It opened with a capital of $5,000.00 of which $3,000.00
was subscribed by Zung Ts San (陳志珊), a Cantonese
reported to be an ex-Senior Staff-Employee of the Li
Wei Lo Gambling Den, 1238 Yu Yuen Road, O.O.L., which
was incorporated on 31.7.40 with the "Loh Kuo Hotel"
(六國飯店 ), a gambling den at 346 Avenue Haig,
O.O.L.

East Asia Amusement Resort (東亞游藝場 ).

The East Asia Amusement Resort commenced for
business on August 14, 1940, at House 1, Lane 1249 Loh
Ka Pang Road (陸家浜路), Nantao, near St.Catherine's
Bridge. Games of chance including "Bah Jiu" and "Yao
Tan" etc., are provided in the inner rooms of the premises

泰山乐园（The Tai San Happy Garden）。

泰山乐园是一家赌场，位于城内乔家底路西江元路智安里（Ts An Li）1-2号，于1940年8月6日开业。由沈心梅（Sung Sing Fu，音译）经营，年龄约50岁，杭州人，他是“中华工人福益会南市分会”主席，该会办事处位于城内乔家底路大庆路15号。开业资本为5,000.00美元，其中3,000.00美元由陈志珊（Zung Ts San，音译）认购，陈系广东人，据报曾是位于欧战纪念路（O.O.L.）豫园路1238号的利威罗（Li Wei Lo）赌场的高级职员，该赌场于1940年7月31日与位于欧战纪念路海格路346号的六国饭店（Loh Kuo Hotel）赌场合并。

东亚游艺场（East Asia Amusement Resort）。

Subject ____ New gambling dens established in Nantao.

Made by ____ Forwarded by ____

Three new gambling dens have been
established in Nantao, making a total of 11
such establishments at present in operation
in Nantao.

The particulars of the three new
dens are given hereunder :-

Si Yuen Ball Room (    )

On August 1, 1940, a gambling den
entitled Si Yuen Ball Room came into existence
at 1451 Chung Hwa Road, near the Old West Gate,
Nantao. "Roulette" and "Yao Tai" etc. are
provided in the upstairs rooms of the premises
while the downstairs rooms comprises a ball room
and a billiard room. It is conducted by Li
Siao Pao (    ), a satellite of Loo Ying
(    ), Commissioner of the "Shanghai City
Government Police Bureau". Li is wanted on
a charge of malfeasance in office while serving
as a detective sub-inspector about 7 years ago,
in the now defunct Shanghai City Government
Police (old P.S.B.).

The opening ceremony for the ballroom
took place at 6.30 p.m. August 1, and was
attended by a large gathering of some 400 persons,
including Miss Buh Hong (    ), Miss Li Hong
(    ) two movie stars and Mr. Wong Tse

日期 ____ 1940年8月5日。

主题 ____ 南市新设赌场。

制作人 ____ 转呈人 ____

南市新开设了三家赌场，使得目前南市正在运营的此类场所总数达到11家。

这三家新赌场的具体情况如下：-

西园舞厅 (    )

1940年8月1日，一家名为“西园舞厅”的赌场在南市老西门附近的中华路1451号成立。该场所楼上房间提供“轮盘赌”和“摇摊”等赌博项目，而楼下房间则包括一个舞厅和一个台球室。该场所由李筱宝 (    ) 经营，他是“上海市政府警察局”局长卢英 (    ) 的亲信。李筱宝约七年前在已解散的上海市政府警察（旧警察局）担任侦探副巡官期间，因涉嫌渎职而被通缉。

舞厅的开幕仪式于8月1日下午6时30分举行，约有400人参加，其中包括电影明星白虹小姐 (    )、李红小姐 (    ) 以及王芝

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE 31-JUL-1940）
（批：30/7）

Two new gambling dens recently came into
existence in Nantao making a total of 8 such
establishments now operating in Nantao. The particulars
of the two new dens are as follows :-
The Heng An Company (恒安公司), House No.
16 Heng An Faung alleyway, Faung Pang Road, Nantao,
was opened on July 21, with a capital of $5,000. The
conductor is one TSANG MONG SUNG (張夢生), a
native of Shanghai and a tudee of LI SIAO PAO
(李筱寶), who is a satellite of LOO YING (盧英),
Commissioner of the "Shanghai City Government Police
Bureau," and wanted on a charge of malfeasance in the
office while he was a detective sub-inspector, about
seven years ago, in the defunct City Government Police (old P.S.B.)
The other is named The Yung Chi Dong Loh
Club (榮記同樂俱樂部) which was opened for business
at No. 34 An Zung Ka, Min Kuo Road, Nantao, on July 29.
The conductor is one TSANG PING YUNG (張炳榮),
age 35, native of Shanghai, a wellknown loafer in the
Pakhoi Road area, International Settlement.
It is learned that opium smoking paraphernalia
is provided in the upper floors of the gambling den
for the entertainment of patrons.
These two establishments are in no way
connected with the gambling dens in the Western
District of Shanghai.

FILE
Pan Lien-pih
D. I.
D. C. (Special Branch).

（批：7月30日）

南市最近新开设了两家赌场，使得目前在南市运营的此类场所总数达到8家。这两家新赌场的具体情况如下：
恒安公司 (Heng An Company)，位于南市方浜路恒安坊16号，于7月21日开业，资本为5,000元。负责人为张梦生 (TSANG MONG SUNG)，上海人，是李筱寶 (LI SIAO PAO) 的“徒弟”，而李筱寶是“上海市政府警察局”局长卢英 (LOO YING) 的党羽。卢英约七年前在已解散的旧市政府警察局（即旧特别市警察局）担任侦探副督察期间，因涉嫌渎职而被通缉。
另一家名为荣记同乐俱乐部 (Yung Chi Dong Loh Club)，于7月29日在南市民国路安宗街34号开业营业。负责人为张炳荣 (TSANG PING YUNG)，35岁，上海人，是公共租界北海路地区知名的无业游民。
据悉，该赌场的楼上提供鸦片烟具，以供顾客娱乐消遣。
这两家场所与上海西区的赌场没有任何关联。

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE S. B. REGISTRY No S. 11. ( ) 1039 p/d Date March 29, 1940.）

Subject. Gambling Dens in Nantao - Summary.

Made by D. I. Pan Lien Pih Forwarded by D. I. Crawford

No gambling dens are operating in Nantao. All such establishments closed down on March 19 after having been raided by the Japanese Gendarmerie.
Hwo Wei Lottery is, however, flourishing in Nantao; the authorities there apparently pay no attention to it.
A proclamation directed against gambling dens, was issued on March 23, 1940, over the joint signatures of Isamu Kawakami (川上勇), officer-in-charge of the Nantao Section of the Japanese Gendarmerie, and Shen Sze Ching (沈書經), Chief of the Nanteo Administrative Bureau of the Shanghai City Government.
This document, when translated, reads as follows :-
"Nantao, after its reopening, has been set in good order and is expected to become prosperous by promoting industry and commerce. However, unscrupulous elements established gambling dens in the name of "companies" and "clubs" which were harmful to the people and prejudicial to peace and order. Gambling is strictly prohibited and those gambling den conductors should give up their illegal enterprise and engage in business pursuits. The people should refrain from gambling and landlords should not lease their houses to gambling dens, failing which they would be punished. The undersigned have been promised by the Japanese Military Authorities to render us assistance in suppressing gambling.
(Chopped) Isamu Kawakami
(Chopped) Shen Sze Ching"

Pan Lien-pih
D. I.

D. C. (Special Branch).

日期 1940年3月29日。

主题。南市赌场 - 摘要。

呈报人 潘连璧 督察 转呈人 克劳福德 督察

南市目前没有赌场在运营。所有此类场所在被日本宪兵队突击搜查后，均于3月19日关闭。
然而，“华威彩票” (Hwo Wei Lottery) 在南市生意兴隆；当地当局显然对此不予关注。
一份针对赌场的公告于1940年3月23日发布，由日本宪兵队南市section负责人川上勇 (Isamu Kawakami) 和上海市政府南市行政局局长沈书经 (Shen Sze Ching) 联合签署。
该文件翻译如下：
“南市自重新开放以来，秩序井然，预计通过促进工商业将变得繁荣。然而，不法分子以‘公司’和‘俱乐部’的名义设立赌场，危害民众，损害和平与秩序。严禁赌博，那些赌场负责人应放弃非法经营，从事正当商业活动。民众应避免赌博，房东不得将房屋出租给赌场，否则将受到惩罚。日军当局已承诺协助我们镇压赌博。
（盖章）川上勇
（盖章）沈书经”

潘连璧
督察

副总监（特务科）。

Made by D. I. Crawford Forwarded by Supt. J. Mason

New establishments

Between March 14 and March 21, 1940,
seven new gambling dens came into existence in
Nantao, and one den resumed operations, bringing
the total number to 18 as against 10 on March
15. Brief particulars of the new establishments
are given in the attached list as a supplement
to the one forwarded on March 15.

All gambling dens in Nantao suspended
operations on March 19 following raids made on
those places by the Japanese Gendarmerie and
are still closed to-day, March 21st. Particulars
of the raids are given hereunder.

Raids

The 140 or more gamblers and employees
who were arrested by the Japanese Gendarmerie on
March 13, 1940, during a raid on the Hwa Sung
(華生) and Hang Oen (恆安) Gambling Dens,
both situated in Lane 870 Fang Pang Road, were
released on March 16 after a fine of $5,000
having been paid by the conductors of the dens.
The Hang Oen Gambling den then resumed operations
on March 17, but the other den failed to re-open.

During the afternoon of March 19, a party
of Japanese Gendarmes accompanied by members of
the Nantao Police Bureau, visited all gambling

新设场所

1940年3月14日至3月21日期间，南市新开设了七家赌场，另有一家恢复营业，使得总数达到18家，而3月15日时为10家。新设场所的简要情况列于附件清单中，作为对3月15日所呈送清单的补充。

南市所有赌场在日本宪兵队对这些场所进行突击搜查后，于3月19日暂停营业，截至今日（3月21日）仍处于关闭状态。突击搜查的详细情况如下。

突击搜查

1940年3月13日，日本宪兵队在突击搜查位于方浜路870弄的华生 (Hwa Sung) 和恒安 (Hang Oen) 两家赌场时，逮捕了140多名赌徒和雇员。在赌场负责人缴纳5,000元罚款后，这些人于3月16日被释放。随后，恒安赌场于3月17日恢复营业，但另一家赌场未能重新开业。

Subject. Gambling Dens in Nantao - Summary.

Made by D. I. Crawford Forwarded by Supt. J. Mason

Comm:
Sir:
R. Horks.
D. C. (Sp. Br.)

（左侧圆形印章：SHANGHAI M.B. 17 MAR. 1940 COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE）
（左侧手写标记：S & C G）

Gambling establishments were started in
Nantao towards the end of February, 1940, and
there are ten dens now operating in that locality.
At one time there were 14 dens but this was prior
to March 14 and four suspended operations.

A list of the gambling dens situated in
Nantao including those which have suspended
operations, has been compiled and is attached
to this report.

These gambling dens are not in possession
of any form of licence but the conductors
maintain they have secured verbal permission
from the Japanese Gendarmerie and the Shanghai
City Government Police Bureau. They pay
approximately one hundred dollars per day as
a fee for each gambling den but in spite of this
arrangement, raids are made on the dens by the
Japanese Military Authorities, the Japanese
Garrison Headquarters, and the Shanghai City
Government Police independently.

Raids and other Incidents

On February 22, the Nantao Police raided
four gambling dens (Nos. 1, 2, 3 and 4 in the
attached list) and arrested therefrom 240
gamblers and employees of the establishments.

（左侧圆形印章：上海工部局 1940年3月17日 专员办公室）
（左侧手写标记：S & C G）

赌场于1940年2月底在南市开始设立，目前该地区有十家赌场正在营业。曾一度有14家赌场，但这是在3月14日之前，其中四家已停止营业。

已编制一份位于南市的赌场名单，包括那些已停止营业的赌场，并附于本报告之后。

这些赌场均未持有任何形式的执照，但经营者声称已获得日本宪兵队和上海市政府警察局的口头许可。他们为每家赌场每天支付约一百美元的费用，但尽管有此安排，日本军方当局、日本驻军司令部以及上海市政府警察局仍独立对赌场进行突击搜查。

突击搜查及其他事件

2月22日，南市警察突袭了四家赌场（附件名单中的第1、2、3和4号），并从那里逮捕了240名赌徒和赌场雇员。

The dens resumed operations the same day almost
immediately after the raids had been carried
out and the arrested persons were released
the next day, February 23, after paying fines
ranging from $5.00 to $100.00.

On March 7, a new gambling den named
Yung Sung Company (榮生公司) (No. 8 in the
attached list) commenced business but was
immediately raided by a squad of Chinese Police
and Japanese gendarmes, who seized the gambling
paraphernalia together with a sum of about
$1,000 but made no arrests. The den, however,
resumed operations upon the departure of the
raiding party.

On March 13, a new gambling den named
Hwa Sung Company (華生公司) (No. 14 in the
attached list) commenced operations at No. 44,
Lane 870, Fang Pang Road and at 12.30 p.m.,
a party of more than ten loafers, one of whom
was armed with a pistol, visited this den and
demanded gratuities which were refused with
the result an alarm was raised compelling the
den to close its doors. A party of Japanese
gendarmes rushed to the scene on the alarm
and ordered the den to open its doors but being
refused fired five or six shots from their rifles

在突击搜查行动结束后，这些赌场几乎立即于当天恢复营业，被捕人员于次日（2月23日）在缴纳了5.00美元至100.00美元不等的罚款后被释放。

3月7日，一家名为“荣生公司”（榮生公司）（附件名单第8号）的新赌场开始营业，但随即遭到一队中国警察和日本宪兵的突袭，他们没收了赌博用具以及约1,000美元的现金，但未实施逮捕。然而，在突袭队伍离开后，该赌场恢复了营业。

3月13日，一家名为“华生公司”（華生公司）（附件名单第14号）的新赌场在方浜路870弄44号开始营业。下午12时30分，一伙十多名流氓（其中一人手持手枪）光顾该赌场并索要小费，遭到拒绝后引发警报，迫使赌场关闭大门。一队日本宪兵闻讯赶至现场，命令赌场开门，但遭到拒绝，于是向空中开了五到六枪。

March 14. 1940. Morning Translation.

Chinese-American Daily News, Ta Mei Pao, National Herald,
Shun Pao, Sin Wan Pao, Central China Daily News :-

GAMBLERS IN HWA SUNG GAMBLING DEN IN NANTAO KILLED BY
JAPANESE GENDARMES

At 2.p.m. yesterday, shooting was heard at
Nanyang Kiao (南陽桥) on the border of the French
Concession and Nantao.)
Investigations show that the shooting was
on Fang Pang Road (方浜路), Nantac. After the re-opening
of Nantao, many people entered the district and established
gambling dens there. Thus, Lane 270 Heng An Fang(恒安坊)
on Fang Pang Read near Nanyang Kiao became the centre of
the gambling area. Raids on these dens have constantly
occurred for they do not possess proper licences.
Yesterday, a party of Japanese gendarmes
numbering about 70 men raided the Hwa Sung Gambling Den
(華生 ), 44 Hong An Fang. On the arrival of the
gendarmes, the gamblers scattered, whereupon the gendarmes
gave chase and opened fire. As a consequence, two gamblers
were killed.
Upon receipt of a report, the French Police
closed the various iron gates on the border of the French
Concession and Nantao. The gates were re-opened later.

《申报》、《新闻晚报》、《华中日报》：

**南市华生赌场赌徒遭日本宪兵击毙**

昨日下午2时，法租界与南市交界处的南阳桥（南陽桥）传来枪声。
调查显示，枪击发生在南市方浜路（方浜路）。南市重新开放后，许多人进入该区并设立赌场。因此，靠近南阳桥的方浜路恒安坊（恒安坊）270弄成为赌博区域的中心。由于这些赌场没有合法执照，针对它们的突击搜查不断发生。
昨天，一队约70人的日本宪兵突袭了位于恒安坊44号的华生赌场（華生）。宪兵到达时，赌徒四散奔逃，宪兵随即追击并开枪。结果，两名赌徒被击毙。
接到报告后，法国警察关闭了法租界与南市边界上的各扇铁门。随后铁门重新打开。

pages.en:
Nantao Gambling Dens
Closed

Newly-opened Establishments
Enjoy Short Life

Leading Chinese newspapers report that all newly-established gambling houses in Nantao were closed on Saturday for unknown reasons. Since Saturday morning all gambling houses in the city including the Sen Sen Company have been closed; all advertisements inviting customers being torn down.

Among the five gambling houses newly established in Chiu Mow Ti (formerly known to many as the "opium street") and West Gate three or four have also closed business. Even the Ta Chuan Fu Gambling House located in the Kwan Ti Miao (Temple) has been closed.

The reports admit that it is difficult to know whether or not their closure is due to official restriction but the "Shun Pao" asserts that authorities of the French Concession have written a letter to Mayor Fu Siao-en of the Shanghai Special Municipality asking the latter to suspend the new gambling business. Mayor Fu has not yet made a reply, it is stated.

Confused reports have recently been circulated regarding the closure of gambling houses in the western district. Although it has been admitted that the authorities concerned have decided to close these establishments, interested parties are hesitating to entertain the idea and it has even been suggested in Chinese reports that gambling house managers there may offer an increase of licence fees to prolong the existence of their establishments.

Previous reports were to the effect that following the reaching of an understanding between the Shanghai Municipal Council and Japanese authorities in regard to the policing of the western district, gambling house managers in the district were planning to move their business into Nantao. It is reliably learned, however, that practically all new gambling houses in Nantao have not yet secured their licences.
pages.zh:
南市赌场
关闭

新开设场所
好景不长

中文主流报纸报道，所有在南市新设立的赌场均于周六因不明原因关闭。自周六上午起，包括森森公司在内的全市所有赌场均已关闭；所有招揽顾客的广告均被撕除。

在九亩地（许多以前称为“鸦片街”）和西门新开的五家赌场中，有三四家也已停业。甚至位于关帝庙的大全福赌场也已关闭。

报道承认，很难知道其关闭是否由于官方限制，但《申报》断言，法租界当局已致函上海特别市市长傅筱庵，要求后者暂停新的赌博业务。据悉，傅市长尚未作出答复。

最近流传着关于西区赌场关闭的混乱报道。虽然有关当局已决定关闭这些场所这一事实得到承认，但利益相关方仍犹豫不决，中文报道甚至暗示，那里的赌场经理可能会通过增加执照费来延长其场所的存续时间。

此前的报道称，在上海公共租界工部局与日本当局就西区警务问题达成谅解后，该区的赌场经理正计划将业务迁至南市。然而，据可靠消息获悉，南市几乎所有新赌场尚未获得执照。

pages.en:
Gambling Dens in
Nantao Opposed

Concession Authorities
May Close Gates If Dens
Establishments Opened

French Concession authorities may
close the iron gates to Nantao if
gambling dens should be permitted to
operate there, it was reliably learned
yesterday.

At the same time, Chinese press
reports according to which M. M.
Baudez, French Consul-General, and
Father R. Jacquinot, S.J., had for-
warded a letter to the Nantao au-
thorities, informing the latter that
gambling dens would not be tolerated,
were denied.

Father Jacquinot told the "North-
China Daily News" that he was ob-
viously opposed to the establishment
of gambling dens but that to his
knowledge, no steps had been taken
officially.

Meanwhile, unofficial quarters said
last night that the removal to
Nantao of "bad lands" gambling dens
would be strenuously opposed and
may result in the closing of the iron
gates separating the Concession from
Nantao. Passes for pedestrians, which
were abolished in January, these
same quarters added, may also be in-
troduced again in the event that
French wishes in this connection are
not respected.

On the other hand, it is known that
certain establishments in Nantao per-
mit gambling although they have no
licences.
pages.zh:
南市赌场
遭反对

若赌场
开业，租界当局
可能关闭铁门

据昨日可靠消息，如果允许在南市经营赌场，法租界当局可能会关闭通往南市的铁门。

与此同时，中文报刊关于法国总领事鲍岱兹先生（M. M. Baudez）和耶稣会士雅基诺神父（Father R. Jacquinot, S.J.）已向南市当局去函，告知后者不容忍赌场的报道，遭到否认。

雅基诺神父告诉《字林西报》，他显然反对设立赌场，但据他所知，官方并未采取任何行动。

与此同时，非官方人士昨晚表示，将坚决反对将“不良地带”的赌场迁至南市，这可能导致关闭分隔租界与南市的铁门。这些人士还补充说，如果法方在此事上的意愿得不到尊重，今年1月已废除的行人通行证也可能重新实施。

另一方面，据悉南市某些场所虽无执照，却允许赌博。

Made by. D. I. Pan Lien-pih. Forwarded by. D. I. Crawford.

E (2)

Acting on instructions received from the Japanese Advisors, a party of Police from the Nantao Police Bureau and the City Temple Police Bureau of the Shanghai City Government raided the following gambling dens under their jurisdiction between 3 p.m. and 4 p.m. February 22, 1940.

Hang Oen Company - 24 Hang Oen Faung, Wang Pang Road.
Shing Fah Company - 77 Oong Ka Loong.
Sun Sun Company - No.1/139 Oen Zung Ka.
Tao Shing Company - 479 Foh U Road.

A total number of about 240 gamblers including employees of the dens were arrested and charged.

According to the conductors of the gaming establishments, the Police Bureaux carried out the raids in order to obtain funds for the upkeep of their offices. Despite the raids the dens are now doing business as usual.

Another two new gaming houses have been established at No.479 Foh U ( 福佑 ) Road and 77 Cong Ka Loong ( 翁家弄 ) off Old West Gate, Nantao, their names being the "Pao Shing Company" ( 寶興公司 ) and "Shing Fah Company" ( 興發公司 ) respectively.
These gaming houses commenced functioning on February 20, 1940 and are operating daily from 9 a.m. to 6 p.m.
The number of gamblers frequenting these places are estimated to range from 200 to 400 daily.

The Pao Shing Company is sponsored by a loafer Chang Shing Pao ( 張興寶 ) who has subscribed $3,000.00 towards the capital while the Shing Fah Company is supported by another loafer named Ting Lieu Dao ( 丁流桃 ) alias Ting Siao Mo Tse ( 丁小麻子 ) who is a henchman of Hsu Foh Pao ( 許福寶 ).

Owing to the fact that these dens are conducted by petty loafers they have not succeeded in winning the support of residents in the city to any great extent. It is reported that the owners of the gaming houses mentioned hope to either sell the dens at a rich profit to the well known gambling den owners in the Western District or admit the latter to part ownership.

A gaming house bearing the name "Hang Oen Company" (恒安公司 ) has been established, under the sponsorship of one Li Siao Pao (李筱寶 ) with a capital of $5,000.00, at House 24 Lane 870 (Hang Cen Faung), Fang Pang Road, Nantao, which is approximately 100 yards east of the Nan Yang Jao, French Concession. Subject. Gambling Dens in Western District reported to

Made by D.S.I. Liao Chung-chien. Forwarded by D. I. Crawford.

With reference to the attached translation
of an extract from the "Ta Mei Pao" dated 30/1/40
on a proposal of the Amusement Supervision Department,
9/470 Yu Yuen Road, to remove the gambling dens in the
Western District, O.O.L., to Nantao, which has now
been reopened, discreet enquiries have failed to
confirm the report.

However, it will be noted that the gambling
dens in the Western District situated in Jessfield
area (i.e. the area to the north of Yu Yuen Road), have
been suffering from business depression because the
number of visitors has fallen considerably as a result of
the unsettled condition prevailing in that district since
September 1939 when "Shanghai City Government" Police
assisted by Wang Ching Wei organs made vigorous
attempts to seize the right of policing the extra-
Settlement roads area. These dens consequently cut
to the minimum the salaries of the employees and the
remuneration regularly offered to loafers in that area
but the measures of retrenchment have only made matters
worse as employees of the dens, all of whom come from
the underworld fraternity, and the loafers in that
district have resorted to armed robberies and other
criminal activities in order to augment their incomes
thus increasing the disinclination of gamblers to visit
these establishments.

主题：据报西区赌场正迁往南市。

由副督察廖仲坚（Liao Chung-chien）撰写。由督察克劳福德（Crawford）转呈。

关于随附的1940年1月30日《大美报》摘录译文，其中提到位于愚园路9/470号的娱乐监管部提议将越界筑路区西区的赌场迁至已重新开放的南市，经秘密查访，未能证实该报道。

然而，值得注意的是，位于兆丰公园地区（即愚园路以北区域）的西区赌场因生意萧条而遭受损失，访客数量大幅下降，这是由于自1939年9月以来该地区局势动荡所致；当时“上海市政府”警察在汪精卫派系机构的协助下，大力试图夺取越界筑路区域的 policing 权。因此，这些赌场将员工薪资及定期支付给该地区流氓的报酬削减至最低限度，但紧缩措施反而使情况恶化，因为赌场的员工均来自黑社会团伙，加之该地区的流氓为了增加收入而诉诸武装抢劫和其他犯罪活动，从而进一步降低了赌客光顾这些场所的意愿。

    Many of the proprietors are contemplating
closing down of their establishments but they hesitate
to do so when they take into consideration the fact
that this would result in the cancellation of their
permits by the Amusement Supervision Department.
The possession of the permits is highly prized by the
proprietors because the Amusement Supervision
Department is said to have decided not to issue any
fresh permits in addition to the present number.
    Some of the proprietors did discuss among
themselves the removal of the establishments to
Nantao which has now reopened but investigation showed
that conditions in that area are far from bright and
the suggestion is said to have been dropped for the
time being.

                                Lio Chung Chen

January 30,1940. Morning Translation.

Ta Mei Pao :-

ALL GAMBLING DENS IN WESTERN DISTRICT REPORTED TO BE
MOVING INTO NANTAO

It is learned that with the complete reopening
of Nantao, the Japanese Amusement Resorts Supervision
Office in the Western District will issue an order notifying
all the gambling establishments in the Western District
to remove into Nantao. This order was the subject of a
recent meeting of the conductors of the various gambling
establishments.

（印：SHANGHAI 31 JAN. 1940 COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE）

1940年1月30日。晨间译文。

《大美报》：-

据报西区所有赌场正迁往南市

据悉，随着南市的全面重新开放，日本驻西区娱乐游乐场所监管办公室将发布命令，通知西区所有赌博场所迁往南市。该命令是近期各赌博场所经营者会议的主题。

（印章：上海 1940年1月31日 处长办公室）

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. 8039 A
Special Branch
Date February 7, 1938.
SECRET
Subject Situation in Nantao
Made by D. I. Pan Lien-pih Forwarded by C. Crawford D. S.

Two gambling dens have been recently established
in Nantao by the Japanese ronins and Chinese "traitors",
one is situated at Wong Ka Chuen Road, and the other at
115 Yien Hai Road. A narcotic and drug smuggling centre
is also in existence at 155 Yien Hai Road, Nantao. It is
reported that those people residing in the Settlement and
French Concession who wish to visit those gambling dens
first proceed to Jessfield Village, where they are
conveyed to Nantao via Chungshan Road in hired motor cars,
the arrangements being made by the managements of the
gambling dens. Both places cater to opium addicts when
they are gambling. It is believed that each gambling
den and also the narcotic smuggling centre pay $30.00 a
day to the Japanese Military Authorities. There is
also a brothel for Japanese soldiers at Meng Hwa Ka,
Nantao.

The Zah Hwei Jao, a bridge at Zah Hwei Kong
which was destroyed during the hostilities, has been
repaired by the Japanese military and renamed the
"Sze Mao Jao" ( 市 毛 桥 ).

Copy to E.

机密
主题：南市局势
由督察潘连璧（Pan Lien-pih）撰写，由克劳福德（C. Crawford）副督察转呈。

近期，日本浪人和中国“汉奸”在南市开设了两家赌场，一家位于王家泉路，另一家位于盐海路115号。此外，南市盐海路155号还存在一个麻醉品和毒品走私中心。据报道，居住在租界和法租界并希望前往这些赌场的人，首先前往兆丰村，随后由赌场管理层安排，乘坐雇佣的汽车经中山路被运送至南市。这两处场所在赌博的同时也迎合鸦片瘾君子。据悉，每家赌场以及毒品走私中心每天向日本军方支付30.00美元。此外，南市梦花街还有一家供日本士兵使用的妓院。

位于曹家港的曹家桥在战事期间被毁，现已由日军修复，并更名为“市毛桥”（Sze Mao Jao）。

抄送 E.
